newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai short-term money supply sufficient.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai short-term money supply sufficient.

text.p: Shanghai's short-term money supply is sufficient and is helping to boost business on the Shanghai Short-term Financial Funding Centre, a money brokerage run by the central bank, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.
The surplus of supply is mainly due to continued growth in deposits in banks and other financial institutions, it said without elaborating.

Statistics issued by the centre show that turnover of the centre increased by 10.39 percent in September to 16.3 billion yuan, most of it from trading in early maturing contracts of two to 10 days, the newspaper said.
